description: Applies to the main window and to every document window `open_in_new_window` creates, which are labelled `doc-<n>`. A window outside this list gets NO permissions at all, not reduced ones, so a second window would fail every `invoke` it made. Minimal surface. The frontend gets NO filesystem, shell, or http permission. Every privileged action goes through a named, validated #[tauri::command] in src/ipc.rs, which is the only place path validation lives.
